product_metadata.title: Chef's Path 32 Piece Food Storage Containers Set with 16 Easy Snap Lids +16 Airtight Containers for Pantry & Kitchen Organization -Plastic, BPA-Free with Free Labels & Marker
features: Top Notch Kitchen Organization - This 32 piece set includes 16 food containers with 16 lids along with reusable labels and marker.These space-saving and efficient pantry organizers will keep cabinets, freezer, refrigerator and kitchen organized while adding to the decor.

Size Variety - These air tight containers come in a wide variety of shapes and sizes for all your storage needs. Includes (3) 35oz rectangular container [4.4 cups]; (3) 30oz rectangular containers [3.8 cups]; (3) 25oz round containers [3.1 cups]; (3) 19oz rectangular containers [2.4 cups] and (4) 12oz rectangular containers [1.5 cups]

Prolonged Freshness - The 4-hinge locking system of these plastic food containers with lids airtight forms a seal to ensure freshness, no foul odor and keep things leakproof. These fridge storage containers are perfect for storing leftovers and enjoy them later on with your family

Microwave & Dishwasher Safe - These stackable food containers will save space and enhance your food storage experience. They can be easily carried for taking lunch to the office, school or travel. These containers for food are also stain resistant, easy to clean and are dishwasher friendly

Resourceful - We know you will love our clear food storage containers. As pioneers of pantry organization and kitchen storage products, we designed this product to assist you in your daily life. Our storage containers are ideal for fruits, vegetables, cooked meals, dry food and even gravies
